remaining_limitations: Factory PAR resistance, reactance and tap-dependent characteristics remain unverified. Zero resistance is a lossless DC placeholder, not a claim of zero physical resistance.
The 40-to-32-degree conversion assumes 40 degrees is the no-load angle. Public SA2510 does not explicitly use that label.
The normal bypass-open topology is documented; these MAT files do not establish hourly breaker or tap states.
Phases inferred later from P34 targets are model controls, not measured physical taps.

Raw P34 has roughly five-minute records with a literal Flow(MWH) header. The Market Participants User Guide describes hourly reports and does not resolve the native subhourly unit label. The existing numeric-as-MW convention remains qualified, with no factor-of-12 rescaling.
The Dover direction diagram is from July 2026 and has no Dover-specific effective date. The December 3, 2024 note applies to Moses only.
